name: AxialAttention

x.description: input image tensor (B, C, H, W)

reference:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(x, dim=None, heads=8):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    b, c, h, w = x.shape
    if dim is None:
        dim = c
    head_dim = dim // heads
    inner_dim = head_dim * heads
    to_q = nn.Linear(dim, inner_dim, bias=False).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    to_kv = nn.Linear(dim, 2 * inner_dim, bias=False).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    to_out = nn.Linear(inner_dim, dim).to(device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)

    x_perm = x.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).contiguous()
    out = torch.zeros_like(x_perm)

    seq_h = x_perm.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).contiguous().view(b * w, h, c)
    q_h = to_q(seq_h).view(b * w, h, heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
    kv_h = to_kv(seq_h).chunk(2, dim=-1)
    k_h = kv_h[0].view(b * w, h, heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
    v_h = kv_h[1].view(b * w, h, heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
    attn_h = F.softmax(torch.matmul(q_h, k_h.transpose(-2, -1)) / (head_dim ** 0.5), dim=-1)
    out_h = torch.matmul(attn_h, v_h).transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(b * w, h, inner_dim)
    out_h = to_out(out_h).view(b, w, h, c).permute(0, 2, 1, 3)

    seq_w = x_perm.view(b * h, w, c)
    q_w = to_q(seq_w).view(b * h, w, heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
    kv_w = to_kv(seq_w).chunk(2, dim=-1)
    k_w = kv_w[0].view(b * h, w, heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
    v_w = kv_w[1].view(b * h, w, heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
    attn_w = F.softmax(torch.matmul(q_w, k_w.transpose(-2, -1)) / (head_dim ** 0.5), dim=-1)
    out_w = torch.matmul(attn_w, v_w).transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(b * h, w, inner_dim)
    out_w = to_out(out_w).view(b, h, w, c)

    out = out_h + out_w
    return out.permute(0, 3, 1, 2).contiguous()
description: Axial attention applied independently along height and width axes.
